objective: Validate the provider token counters that OllamaModelProvider.route() copies into last_call, so input_tokens and output_tokens are either an absent None or a non-negative integer, and a malformed counter is refused with a bounded LocalModelError instead of reaching model-call telemetry or cost evidence.
acceptance: a missing prompt_eval_count or eval_count stays None in last_call and is never recorded as zero
a present counter is recorded exactly when it is a non-negative integer, including zero
a negative, fractional, boolean or string counter is refused as an invalid model response
a refused counter leaves last_call empty, so no partially accepted telemetry record survives
the refusal message names the offending field with a stable bounded text and never echoes the provider body or the offending value
absent, zero, positive, negative, fractional, boolean and string values are covered independently for both counters
redaction preserves an unavailable None counter and a zero counter without inventing a value or a marker
routing, endpoint policy, response bounds and the accepted-response telemetry fields are unchanged
evidence: focused token-counter test output for absent, zero, positive, negative, fractional, boolean and string values on both counters
demonstration that the new counter tests fail against the unvalidated implementation and pass against the fix
valid positive route still records the exact provider counts alongside the unchanged telemetry fields
targeted pytest, ruff and baseline-aware build/verify.sh output
stop_conditions: the fix would invent a token count or convert an unknown value to zero
the fix requires disabling a counter, which is a telemetry contract change rather than value validation
an interfaces schema or libs/contracts change is required
a modification outside allowed_paths is required
